files.description: B10 Data Export Process Flow — 9-page PDF with step-by-step screenshots showing how to use the Data Export feature in ModuleMD WISE. Documents the export request workflow (patient selection, archive naming, encryption), the 3-step processing pipeline (New → InProgress → Completed), and the download mechanism. Shows that exports produce C-CDA XML files organized by patient folder. Also documents patient portal access to C-CDA files. Contains no data dictionary, schema, format specification, or description of export content scope.
